description: Rotate one app key (new key shown once, old key stops immediately) or revoke the app permanently. Both operations keep other apps unchanged; revoke requires gate_create_app to restore access. Use gate_list_apps to find the app; use gate_configure_app to change its settings without replacing its key.

admin_key.description: The project admin key (ga_...). Read it from the .env; never print it.

operation.description: Perform exactly one operation: rotate, revoke.

project_id.description: The project id from gate_create_project, e.g. p1a2b3...
